comparisons.reason: Left requires a comment to quote OP text AND dispute/refute the quoted material; quoting without disputing doesn't count. Right counts any verbatim OP quotation and explicitly says endorsement or refutation is irrelevant. Left is a materially narrower subtype (quote plus refutation), so the row functions differ. Their null rules also differ: left returns null if OP text is missing, while right still gives 1 for an observed quote matching available text.
